newsitem.title: USA: GE Medical buys Lockheed Martin unit.
newsitem.headline: GE Medical buys Lockheed Martin unit.

text.p: GE Medical Systems, a unit of General Electric Co, said Tuesday it purchased the assets of Lockheed Martin Medical Imaging Systems, a Lockheed Martin Corp unit that manufactures and sells picture archiving and communication systems.

The picture archiving and communication systems allow medical providers to electronically archive, display and transmit images by magnetic resonance, computed tomography, X-ray and other imaging devices throughout a networked health care system.
This acquisition strengthens GE Medical's position in medical-image networks and health care information systems, said Jeff Immelt, president of GE Medical.
Peter Teets, president of Lockheed Martin Information & Services Sector, said the move is consistent with the company's strategy of focusing on its core businesses.
